_note: User-settings manifest fragment (user-settings-v1) — appended onto the bundled src/manifest.json by main.js::mergeManifestFragments. Adds the in-app personal settings page; the canonical mount is the Nextcloud personal settings panel at /settings/user/decidesk.

pages.title: Personal settings
pages._note: In-app mount of the PER-USER preference sections (notification, display, delegation, communication) — the SPA twin of the Nextcloud personal panel at /settings/user/decidesk. type:'settings' is the app-configuration surface, not the per-user one, and the four sections are bespoke components with their own save semantics rather than a declarative field set, so no standard page type fits. Spec: openspec/specs/user-settings/spec.md
